# Atlas

> Atlas is a pre-release purchasing intermediary and logistics agent for customers in Uzbekistan, delivering to Tashkent. It helps customers find products from foreign stores, review variants, and receive a preliminary estimate of the cost delivered to Tashkent in Uzbek soum.

## What Atlas does

- Shows a public catalog of direct-merchant products and categories.
- Accepts supported product links and imports title, images, price, currency, dispatch country, category, weight estimate, and available variants when the store exposes them.
- Lets an authenticated customer review colour, size, model, price, availability, recipient and delivery address before a simulated checkout.
- Keeps item price, service/buyout fee, merchant shipping, international freight and reserve as separate quote lines.
- Rechecks linked product price, currency and selected availability on the server before cart and checkout.

## What Atlas does not claim

- Imported data is editable assistance, not a guarantee of stock, price, shipping, customs clearance or delivery date.
- Payments, merchant purchase, carrier booking, customs filing and external email/SMS delivery are simulated until production integrations are connected.
- Customs estimates are informational; the final decision and charge belong to the relevant customs process.

## Public pages

- Home page (link estimate, tariffs, FAQ): https://atlasmarket.uz/
- Product catalog with search (`?q=`): https://atlasmarket.uz/catalog
- Store directory: https://atlasmarket.uz/stores
- Customs guidance: https://atlasmarket.uz/customs
- Terms and privacy drafts: https://atlasmarket.uz/legal
- Privacy policy: https://atlasmarket.uz/privacy
- Terms of use (public offer, app terms): https://atlasmarket.uz/terms
- Support: https://atlasmarket.uz/support
- Mobile app (iOS and Android): https://atlasmarket.uz/app
- Account deletion instructions: https://atlasmarket.uz/delete-account

Every public page has Uzbek, Russian and English versions: add `?lang=uz`, `?lang=ru` or `?lang=en` (for example https://atlasmarket.uz/customs?lang=ru). Without the parameter a page follows the visitor's saved or browser language and defaults to Uzbek. The legal documents themselves are drafted in Russian until the reviewed translations are ready.

## Discovery and access

The public catalog, store directory, customs guidance, legal, privacy, terms, support, app and account-deletion pages are crawlable. Account, order, passport, declaration, operator, API and other private paths require authentication and are excluded from public discovery.
